paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak ua, tuni a thu ka hon piak, thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih uleh, TOUPA na Pathian un leitung nam tengteng a tungnungpen in ahon bawl ding hi.
heading: Thumanna Vualzawlnate / (Lev 26.3-13; Diu 7.12-24)

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih peuhmah uleh hiai vualzawlna tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon zui ding uhi.
Inn lam leh gam lam ah vualzawl in na om ding uh.
Na gil ua gah, na lei ua gah, na ganhon, na bawngpi leh na belamhon uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuangte uh vualzawl in a-om ding.
Vakkhete vualzawl in na om ding ua, inn a hong lutte leng vualzawl in na om ding uh.
Na melma nou hon doute TOUPA'N ahon zohsak dia; nou hon dou ding in lampi khat ah ahong kuan ding ua, lampi sagih ah ataikek ding uh.
TOUPA'N na buh inn tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah vualzawlna thu ape dia; TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak ah ahon vualzawl ding hi.
Na kiang ua ana kichiam bang in TOUPA'n amah a ding in nam siangthou ding in ahon hihkip ding, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiakte na zuih ua, alampite na zuih phot uleh.
Huchi in leitung a mite'n TOUPA min a sap na hi uh, chih athei ding ua, hon lau ding uhi.
Nou piak dia na pi-le-pute uh TOUPA'N ana chiam gam ah na gil ua gah, na ganhon gah leh na leigah uh TOUPA'N nakpitak in apungsak ding.

TOUPA'N ahun geihgeih in na gam uh vak ding, vuahtui hon pe ding leh na khut koihna tengteng uh hon vualzawl ding in, avan goubawm hoih akihongsak ding hi. Huchi in nam tampi na leitawisak ding ua, nou bel na leitawi kei ding uhi.
TOUPA'N amei hilou in, alu in hon bawl dia, anuainung hilou in, atungnung na hi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak, tuni a ka hon piak ngaikhia a, pilvangtak a na zuih uleh.
Tuni a ka hon thupiak mah bang a taklam hiam, veilam hiam a pathian dangte zui leh nasem dia na pialsan kei peuhmah uleh.

Himahleh hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian uh aw hoihtak a na ngaihkhiak louh ua, tuni a ka hon piak thupiak tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh, na tung uah hiai hamsia tengteng ahong tung dia, ahon pha nawn ding uhi.
heading: Thumanlouhna Gahte / (Lev 26.14-46)

paite: Inn lam leh gam lam ah hamsia na thuak ding uh.
Na bawm uh leh na tanghou mekna kuang uh hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
Na gilgahte, na leigahte leh na bawngpi uh leh na belamhon gahte hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
Na pawtkhete uh hamsethuak in a-om ding ua, ahong lutte leng hamsethuak in a-om ding uh.
TOUPA'N na tung uah, na khut koihna tengteng uah hamsia, buaina leh salhna ahon sawl dia, na vuallel ding ua, na mangthang pah ding uh; na thilhih giloute ua kei na hon paisan ziak un.
Luah dia na lutna gam ua kipan ahon hihmanthat masiah TOUPA'N na lak uah hipi alengsak gige ding hi.
TOUPA'N kumzawnna, khosik, bawkna, sat huthutna, namsau, keuna leh muatna in hon gawt dia, na manthat vek masiah uh hiaite'n hon delh ding uhi.
Na lutung ua van dal ahi dia, na nuai ua lei sik ahi ding.
TOUPA'N na gam vuah uh leivui leh vut asuaksak ding a; na manthat masiah uh van a pan na tung uah ahong ke ding hi.
TOUPA'N na melmate uh lak ah hon hihniam dia; amaute dou ding in lampi khat ah na kuankhe ding ua, lampi sagih ah na taikek ding uh. Leitung a lalgamte lak ah paihkhiak in na om ding uhi.
Na luang uh tungleng vasa tengteng leh gamsa tengteng nek ding an ahi dia, mi kuamah in amaute adelhmang kei ding uh.
Hihdam theih louh Aigupta meimatum, chithak, bawkna leh vunthak in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding hi.
Haina, mittawtna leh lunglelhna in TOUPA'N ahon gawt ding.

Mittaw in khomial amaimai bang in, sun khovak nangawn ah na maimai ding ua, na khosakna uah na lamzang kei ding uh. Nuaisiah ding leh gallak ding phet na hi ding ua, hon hunkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding uhi.
Zi na kham ding ua, midang in akithuahpih ding uh. Inn na lam ding ua, na luah kei ding uh. Grephuan na bawl ding ua, agah na ne kei ding uh.

Na mitmuh un na bawngtal uh hon gohsak ding ua, asa na ne kei ding uh. Na mitmuh un na sabiltung uh thagum a suhsak na hi ding ua, piakkik na hi kei ding uh. Na belam uh na melmate uh piak ahi ding; hon hunkhe ding kuamah na nei kei ding uh.
Na tanute uh leh na tapate uh namdangte piak ahi ding ua, nitum in amaute ngai in na en vungvung ding ua, na etetna lam un na mitte uh avai ding; bangmah lah hihtheih na nei kei ding uhi.
Na leigah, na sepkhiak teng uh na theih louh uh nam in ane khin dia, hihgentheih leh hihsiat in na om gige ding uh.
Huchi in hiai thil mu in na hailoh ding uhi.
TOUPA'N na khuk uah, na khe uah, hihdam theih louh meimatum ahon veisak ding, na khepek ua kipan na lusip tanpha un.
Nou leh na kumpipa uh nangawn in na pi-le-pute'n atheih ngei louh uh nam kiang ah TOUPA'N ahon pi dia; huai ah pathian dangte, sing leh suang pathiante nna na sem ding uh.
TOUPA'N hon pimangna ding nam tengteng lak ah lamdang chih leh paunak leh aselam a gentehna na hong hi ding uhi.
Lou ah buhchi tampi na kuankhiakpih ding ua, tawmchik kia na la ding uh, khaupe in anegai vek ding hi.
Grephuan na bawl ding ua, na kem ding ua, himahleh a-uain na dawn kei ding uh. Grep lah na lou kei ding uh, lung in anegai ding hi.
Na gam tengteng uah olive sing na suan ding ua, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding uh, na olive gahte uh apulh khin ding hi.
Tanu tapa na suang ding ua, himahleh sal a kaihmang a, a-om ding ziak un na ompih kha kei ding uh.
Na theikung tengteng uh leh na leigah tengteng uh khaupe an ahi ding.
Gamdangmi na lak ua tengte na tung uah asang hiaihiai ding ua, nou na niam giaigiai ding uh.
Ahon leitawisak ding ua, nou zaw na leitawisak kei ding uh. Amau alu ahi ding ua, nou amei na hi ding uh.
Hiai hamsia tengteng na tung uah ahong tung dia, ahon delh dia, ahon pha dia; hihmanthat a na om masiah uh; athupiak leh adan hon piak zui dia TOUPA na Pathian aw na ngaihsak louh ziak un.
Na tung uah leh na suante uh tung ah tangtawn a dia chiamtehna leh lamdang chih ding in a-om ding uhi.
Thil bangkim a na hong kiningchin ua leng TOUPA na Pathian uh lungsim kipaktak leh nuamsatak a na sepsak louh ziak un.

Huaiziak in noute hon dou dia TOUPA'N ahon sawl ding na melmate uh gilkial, dangtak leh vuaktang leh thil bangkim tasam kawm in na sepsak ding uh. Ahon hihsiat masiah uh na ngawng uah sik hakkol ahon batsak ding uhi.
Gamlapi a pan, kawlmong a pan nou hon dou ding nam, TOUPA'N muvanlai ngumkiak bang in ahon sawl ding; apau uh na theih louh uh nam;
nam lauhuai melpu, upa leng khawk sa lou leh tuailaite leng deihsak tuam lou.
Na ganhon pungte leh na leigah, na manthat masiah uh ane ding ua, buh, uain, thau, na bawnghon leh na belamhonte uh ahawi kei ding uh, na tung ua manna ahon tunsak tan in.

Na gam tengteng ua na muanpen uh, na kulhsangte uh achip tan in na kulh kongpi tengteng uah ahon um ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un nou ahon piak na gam tengteng ua na kulh kongpi tengteng uh ahong um ding uhi.
Na melmate'n hon umbichilh ziak un leh ahon hihmangbatna uah na gil ua gah, TOUPA'N ahon piak na tanu, na tapate sa na ne ding uhi.
Na lak ua minunnem leh chingkam nangawn in leng a-unaupa, ahihkeileh azi it, a-ompih lai atate ngialtak leng a-it kei ding hi.
Bangmah aneih nawn louh ziak in atate uh sa anek ding kuamah ape kei ding hi. Ahon umna uh leh ahon khelhchipna uah, na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon khelhchip ziak un.
Na lak ua numei chinou leh chingek, achinouna leh achingekna ziak a lei leng sik nuam lou in apasal deih mahmah uh, atapate, atanute;
apom lai atasen leh ata piang lai dingte leng a-en moh ding uh. Bangkim ataksap khit ziak in asimnek ding; na melmate'n na kulh kongpi ua ahon lungkiaksak ziak un.
TOUPA na Pathian uh min thupitak leh lauhuaitak na lauhtheihna ding ua, hiai laibu a tuang thu tengteng pilvangtak a na zuih kei uleh;
heading: Pathian In Thumang Ding In Ngen

paite: TOUPA'N noute leh na suante uh tung ah hipi lamdangtak, hipi leng gige, damlouhna haksatak leng gige chi a lengsak ding hi.
Na lauh mahmah uh Aigupta gam hiite na tung uah alengsak nawn dia, hon lenkip ding uhi.
Hiai dan laibu a tuanglou, damlouhna hii chiteng leng na manthat masiah uh TOUPA'N na tung uah alengsak ding hi.
Van a aksi zah hita noute tawmchik kia na hong hita ding uh; TOUPA na Pathian aw na man louh ziak un.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, hon hihhoih ding leh hon pungsak dia TOUPA na tung ua akipah bang in, hon hihmang ding leh bangmah lou hon suah ding in TOUPA na tung uah akipak dia, na va luah ding uh na lutna gam ua kipan suanmang na hi ding uhi.
TOUPA'N kawlmong a pan kawlmong langkhat tan in chi chih lak ah hon hihdalh dia, huai ah sing leh suang, na pi uh leh pute uh tan a na theih ngei louh uh pathian dangte nna na sem ding uhi.
Hiai namte lak ah tawldamna na mu kei ding ua, na khe uh a ding in khawlna a-om kei dia; huai ah, TOUPA'N lungtang ling, mit gim leh lungsim ngui hon pe zaw ding hi.
Na hinna uh lauthawng gige in a-om dia, sun leh zan in lau gige in na om ding ua, na hinna un kitheihchetna anei kei ding hi.
Zingsang in, "Nitak hita maileh aw!" na chi ding ua, nitak in, "Zingsang hita maileh aw!" na chi ding uh, "Thil lauhuai na lungtang un alauh ding ziak leh na mit ua na thil muh ding uh ziak in.

Na mu nawn kei ding uh, na kiang ua ka chih lampi ah long in Aigupta gam ah TOUPA'N ahon pi nawn ding. Huai ah na melmate uh sikhapa ding leh sikhanu dia zuak na hi ding ua, kuamah in ahon lei kei ding uh," achi hi.
